description: A React component for a text input control with validation, debouncing, and rendering logic, used within the Apache Superset project.

classes.name: TextControl
classes.description: A React component class for a customizable text input with validation and debouncing.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles input change, validates and parses input based on props, and triggers onChange callback.

methods.name: debouncedOnChange
methods.description: Debounced version of onChange to limit frequency of validation calls.

methods.name: onChangeWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for input change event, updates state and calls debounced onChange.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the input control with header and input field.
